item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
Improvements

  • Preview toggles such as Pointer and Interaction show a filled background while on.
  • Pro: the daily Workshop update check asks Steam about 50 items per request.

Bug Fixes

  • Pro: scene packages that list a file twice load instead of failing with a duplicate-entry error.
  • Pro: turning Interaction off mid-drag releases the scene's button and no longer swallows the next desktop click.
  • Monitor boards keep updating after their options change.
  • Pro: a paused static scene no longer redraws when an unrelated setting changes.
  • Now Playing no longer restarts its poll when another app quits, and keeps less artwork in memory.
  • Trusting or revoking a web wallpaper's site reloads every display showing it, without clearing pause or rotation elsewhere; revoking stops its scripts at once.
  • Remove All in the overlay editor during a drag no longer brings the removed cards back.
